alice.k: Quick bring-up notes for Hier-11B int4. perf looks great (token cost ~45% down vs fp16) but we see quality drops on long-table generations and multi-turn summaries (>1200 tokens). small rerank stacks OK. full write-up in drive.
ben.t: short signal bullets please?
alice.k: - long-table & >1200-token summaries: ROUGE-L down ~6-8 pts
- numeric-table fidelity issues (tables lose values)
- single-turn chat and short completions within noise
- p95 latency improved ~10ms
claire.v: did you test per-channel KV quant and group-size sweeps?
alice.k: yes. per-channel for KV + group=32 for MLP helped recall ~+3 pts vs default int4 but still ~3 pts shy of fp16. pasted qcfg we used:

```
qcfg = {"precision":"int4", "kv":"per-channel", "mlp_group":32, "calib":"percentile"}
```

ben.t: routing plan idea: mixed-fleet. token_count <= 1024 -> int4; >1024 or table-heavy -> int8. product to add header `X-RW-Mode: table|longform|chat`. fallback: confidence-based switch if perplexity spike >20%.
claire.v: mitigation experiments during canary: (1) per-channel KV sweep, (2) group sizes 16/32/64, (3) hybrid mid-layer int8 for layers 18-24. also add prompt-canonicalization for tables.
alice.k: operational recs: canary 3% for 72h; shadow longform for 14d; human-eval batch 80 long/table samples pre-canary; rollback if ROUGE-L drop >5 pts on production sample or table-fidelity error rate +1%.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: `hier11b-int4-canary` -> starts 2026-05-05T03:00Z, alloc 3%.
alice.k: will assemble short recommendation doc + cost-table for GTN by EOD Monday. thanks all :thumbsup:
